stories.headline: Arm Unveils 136-Core AGI CPU, Its First-Ever Data Center Chip, With Meta as Lead Partner

key_facts.fact: Arm announced the AGI CPU, its first-ever production chip for sale, featuring up to 136 Neoverse V3 cores manufactured on TSMC's 3nm process.
key_facts.excerpt: Arm Holdings plc today debuted a new central processing unit, the AGI CPU... up to 136 Neoverse V3 server CPU cores... Two dies manufactured on a 3-nanometer process.

key_facts.fact: The chip claims more than twice the performance per server rack as Intel silicon and up to $10 billion in savings per gigawatt of data center capacity.
key_facts.excerpt: The company says the chip provides more than twice as much performance per server rack as Intel Corp. silicon... savings of up to $10 billion per gigawatt of data center capacity.

key_facts.fact: The AGI CPU has a 300W TDP, supports DDR5-8800 with up to 6TB capacity per chip, 96x PCIe Gen 6 lanes, and CXL 3.0 memory expansion.
key_facts.excerpt: 300W TDP... DDR5-8800 support with up to 6TB capacity per chip... 96x PCIe Gen 6 lanes... CXL 3.0 memory expansion capability.

key_facts.fact: A reference rack design supports 30 blades with two CPUs each in a 36kW air-cooled configuration, yielding 8,160 total cores per rack.
key_facts.excerpt: A reference design supports two AGI CPUs per blade, accommodating up to 30 blades per 36kW air-cooled rack, yielding 8,160 total cores.

key_facts.fact: Meta Platforms is the lead launch partner, with OpenAI, Cloudflare, Cerebras, SAP, and Lenovo also listed as initial customers.
key_facts.excerpt: Initial customers include OpenAI, Cloudflare, Cerebras, SAP, and Meta Platforms (lead customer). Lenovo and other hardware makers ship compatible servers.

key_facts.fact: Arm expects the new chip unit to generate $15 billion in annual sales within five years, representing a fundamental shift from IP licensing to direct silicon sales.
key_facts.excerpt: Arm is designing its own chip for the first time in its history... The company expects the new unit to generate $15 billion in sales annually in five years.

stories.headline: Cadence and NVIDIA Expand Partnership for AI-Driven Chip Design With Millennium M2000 Supercomputer

key_facts.fact: Cadence Design Systems and NVIDIA are expanding their collaboration to develop AI-driven engineering tools for chip and system design using agentic AI systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Cadence Design Systems and NVIDIA are expanding their collaboration to develop AI-driven engineering tools for chip and system design.

key_facts.fact: The partnership integrates agentic AI agents that can autonomously translate design inputs into workflows, generate chip designs, detect errors, and manage long engineering processes.
key_facts.excerpt: These systems use autonomous agents to translate design inputs into workflows, generate chip designs, detect errors, and manage long engineering processes.

key_facts.fact: The Cadence Millennium M2000 supercomputer uses NVIDIA Grace CPUs and Blackwell GPUs, delivering up to 80x higher processing throughput with reduced power consumption.
key_facts.excerpt: Cadence Millennium M2000 supercomputer... uses NVIDIA Grace CPUs and Blackwell GPUs to improve processing throughput and reduce power consumption. Cadence said the platform can deliver up to 80 times higher throughput.

sources.title: Cadence, NVIDIA expand partnership to build AI-driven chip design systems

stories.headline: Baker Hughes and Google Cloud Partner on AI-Enabled Power Optimization for Data Centers

key_facts.fact: Baker Hughes announced a collaboration with Google Cloud to develop AI-enabled power optimization and sustainability solutions for the global data center sector, announced at CERAWeek 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Baker Hughes (NASDAQ: BKR) on Tuesday announced it is collaborating with Google Cloud to develop advanced AI-enabled power optimization and sustainability solutions for the rapidly growing global data center sector.

key_facts.fact: The collaboration combines Baker Hughes' turbomachinery and power systems expertise with Google Cloud's AI and data analytics to optimize how power is generated, managed, and consumed in data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: Baker Hughes will identify new pathways for efficient, optimized power use through Baker Hughes' deep domain expertise in optimizing turbomachinery and power systems performance, alongside Google Cloud's AI and data analytics.

key_facts.fact: Baker Hughes CEO Lorenzo Simonelli called data center power infrastructure 'one of the most critical drivers of global electricity needs.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Infrastructure that powers the growing demand for AI and cloud computing is becoming one of the most critical drivers of global electricity needs,' said Lorenzo Simonelli, Baker Hughes chairman and CEO.

sources.title: Baker Hughes Develops AI-Enabled Power Optimization and Sustainability Solutions for Data Centers with Google Cloud Technology
Baker Hughes partners with Google Cloud on AI data center power solutions

stories.headline: Amazon's Zoox Brings Purpose-Built Robotaxis to Austin and Miami, Quadruples SF Service Area

key_facts.fact: Zoox announced plans to deploy its purpose-built robotaxis (no steering wheel or pedals) in Austin, Texas and Miami, Florida later in 2026, after nearly two years of test vehicle operations in both cities.
key_facts.excerpt: Zoox is bringing its purpose-built robotaxis to Austin, Texas and Miami, Florida after almost two years of operating its test vehicles in the cities. The company said Tuesday it plans to start offering rides in both locations later this year.

key_facts.fact: Trips in the new cities will initially be limited to Zoox employees and their families before the Explorer program opens to the public.
key_facts.excerpt: Trips will initially be limited to Zoox employees and their family and friends, before it launches its Explorer program.

key_facts.fact: Zoox's San Francisco service area is quadrupling in size to cover the eastern half of the city, while Las Vegas is doubling destinations to include The Sphere, T-Mobile Arena, and the Convention Center.
key_facts.excerpt: The San Francisco service area is quadrupling in size with a focus on 'the eastern half of the city'... In Las Vegas... the company says it is doubling the number of destinations to include The Sphere, T-Mobile Arena, and the Las Vegas Convention Center.

key_facts.fact: CEO Aicha Evans said Zoox is ready to start charging fares once it receives regulatory approval.
key_facts.excerpt: CEO Aicha Evans said the company is ready to start charging fares once it receives regulatory approval.

sources.title: Zoox brings its robotaxis to Austin and Miami

stories.headline: BRINC Unveils Guardian, World's First Starlink-Connected Drone for 911 First Response

key_facts.fact: BRINC released Guardian, described as 'the most capable 911 response drone ever' and the world's first drone with integrated Starlink satellite connectivity.
key_facts.excerpt: BRINC... today announced the release of Guardian, the most capable 911 response drone ever... Guardian is the world's first Starlink-connected drone.

key_facts.fact: Guardian has 62-minute flight time, 8-mile range (vs 3 miles for current systems), 4K video with 640x zoom, dual HD thermal cameras, and a speaker/siren 3x louder than police vehicles.
key_facts.excerpt: 62 minutes flight time... Up to 8 miles operational range compared to 3 miles for current systems... 4K video with 640x total zoom... Dual HD thermal zoom cameras... Speaker and siren 3x louder than police vehicles.

key_facts.fact: Guardian Station, its robotic charging nest, automatically swaps batteries and redeploys to new missions without human intervention, enabling 24/7 operations.
key_facts.excerpt: When Guardian is paired with Guardian Station, its robotic charging nest, the system automatically swaps batteries and redeploys to a new mission... true 24/7 drone readiness.

key_facts.fact: The drone automatically loads mission-specific payloads including defibrillators, flotation devices, and Narcan depending on the emergency type.
key_facts.excerpt: automatically loading the right payload (defibrillators, flotation devices, Narcan, and more) depending on the type of emergency.

key_facts.fact: Over 900 public safety agencies currently use BRINC products, including 20%+ of U.S. SWAT teams. Motorola Solutions holds exclusive North American reseller rights.
key_facts.excerpt: Over 900 public safety agencies currently use BRINC products; 20%+ of U.S. SWAT teams... Motorola Solutions holds exclusive North American reseller rights.

sources.title: BRINC Unveils Guardian, Launching the Next Era of Drone as First Responder

stories.headline: Shield AI and Swiss Destinus Complete European Drone Autonomy Test Campaign in Spain

key_facts.fact: Shield AI and Swiss startup Destinus completed a two-month autonomy integration and flight test campaign in Segovia, Spain, flying the Hornet counter-drone interceptor with Shield AI's Hivemind software.
key_facts.excerpt: Swiss defense startup Destinus and California-based Shield AI have completed a two-month autonomy integration and flight test campaign in Segovia, Spain in which the companies said they successfully flew the European supplier's Hornet drone interceptor with the US firm's Hivemind software.

key_facts.fact: Hivemind autonomously adapted flight paths in real-time, including rerouting away from geofenced locations that were altered while the drone was airborne.
key_facts.excerpt: Shield AI said that Hivemind 'autonomously adapted' Hornet's flight paths in real time, including updated routing away from geofenced locations that were altered while airborne.

key_facts.fact: Hivemind operates onboard the aircraft rather than via ground control, enabling operation in GNSS-denied and communications-degraded environments.
key_facts.excerpt: Hivemind mission autonomy software operates aboard the aircraft... Functions in GNSS-denied or communication-degraded environments.

key_facts.fact: Next phases will expand to advanced mission planning, terrain-aware flight profiles, and coordinated multi-platform behaviors across multiple Destinus platform families.
key_facts.excerpt: Expand autonomy integration across multiple Destinus platform families... Future phases: advanced mission planning, terrain-aware profiles, multi-platform coordination.

sources.title: Swiss Destinus, Shield AI wrap European drone autonomy test campaign

stories.headline: DJI Spin-Off ZYT Readies Autonomous Driving Foundation Model, Signs Volkswagen as First Car Customer

key_facts.fact: ZYT (Zhuoyu Technology), a spin-off from drone maker DJI, will demonstrate a 'mobility foundation model' for autonomous driving at the Beijing auto show in April, with CEO Shen Shaojie saying the AI outdrives him on Shenzhen streets.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese autonomous driving start-up ZYT plans to introduce a new AI driving system at the Beijing auto show in April... ZYT CEO Shen Shaojie told Reuters the system is already a better driver than he is on Shenzhen's crowded streets... The company, a spin-off from Chinese drone maker DJI.

key_facts.fact: The AI was trained not just on road-driving video but on footage from drones, robots, vacuum cleaners, motorcycles, and people carrying cameras, allowing it to work across vehicle types and geographies.
key_facts.excerpt: the system marks a cost-saving shift from how autonomous driving technology is typically built... the ZYT model can figure out how to drive on its own... trained not only on road-driving video, but also on footage from drones, robots, household vacuum cleaners, motorcycles and even people carrying a moving camera.

key_facts.fact: ZYT partners with companies covering 98% of the Chinese truck market and will deploy highway truck driving systems with XCMG, SHACMAN, and SINOTRUK in H1 2026, with upgrades taking just six weeks.
key_facts.excerpt: ZYT already partners with nearly every major Chinese truck maker (covering 98% of the market) and announced plans to deploy highway-based truck driving systems with XCMG, SHACMAN and SINOTRUK in the first half of 2026. Truck upgrades took just six weeks.

key_facts.fact: Volkswagen has signed on as ZYT's first passenger car customer, with the first VW model using the system slated for 2027 and tests underway in Europe.
key_facts.excerpt: Volkswagen has signed on as their first customer, and tests are underway in Europe... the first passenger car expected to use ZYT's system is slated for 2027.

key_facts.fact: ZYT is targeting a Hong Kong IPO possibly in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Targets Hong Kong IPO possibly in 2027.

stories.headline: US Space Force Reassigns GPS III Launch to SpaceX After ULA Vulcan Mid-Flight Anomaly

key_facts.fact: The US Space Force reassigned a GPS III satellite launch from ULA's Vulcan rocket to SpaceX's Falcon 9 due to an ongoing investigation into Vulcan's performance.
key_facts.excerpt: Originally planned to launch aboard the ULA Vulcan rocket, the US Space Force GPS III launch will instead launch on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket. This change in launch service provider is coming amid an ongoing investigation into the ULA Vulcan rocket's performance.

key_facts.fact: During a February 12, 2026 military satellite launch, the Vulcan rocket 'sparked and twisted on its axis mid-flight,' leading to a pause of all military Vulcan launches.
key_facts.excerpt: During a February 12, 2026 military satellite launch, the Vulcan rocket 'sparked and twisted on its axis mid-flight.'... All military Vulcan launches remain paused pending investigation completion.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX is expected to launch the GPS III payload before late April, avoiding significant schedule delays. In exchange, ULA will handle the USSF-70 mission originally assigned to SpaceX.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX is expected to launch the payload 'before late April'... ULA will handle the USSF-70 mission originally assigned to SpaceX next year.

key_facts.fact: Seven additional national security missions were originally scheduled for Vulcan, creating uncertainty about ULA's ability to fulfill its manifest.
key_facts.excerpt: Seven additional national security missions were originally scheduled for Vulcan. The GPS III reassignment creates uncertainty about ULA's ability to fulfill this manifest.

sources.title: SpaceX Will Launch GPS III In Place Of ULA (Again)

stories.headline: Russia's Bureau 1440 Launches First 16 Operational LEO Broadband Satellites to Rival Starlink

key_facts.fact: Bureau 1440, the Russian aerospace firm developing a LEO satellite system for global broadband, launched its first batch of 16 operational satellites on Monday, March 24.
key_facts.excerpt: Bureau 1440, the Russian aerospace firm developing a low-Earth-orbit satellite system for global broadband data delivery, said it launched its first batch of 16 operational satellites on Monday.

key_facts.fact: The company described the deployment as 'a transition from experiment to the creation of a communication service,' marking a shift from test to operational phase.
key_facts.excerpt: Bureau 1440 characterized the deployment as 'a transition from experiment to the creation of a communication service.'

key_facts.fact: Russia remains far behind SpaceX's Starlink network, which has deployed over 10,000 satellites since 2019, while Russia's initiative is just beginning.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia remains substantially behind SpaceX's network. Starlink has deployed over 10,000 satellites since launching operational units in 2019.

sources.title: Russia Challenges Starlink With Launch of 16 Low-Orbit Satellites

stories.headline: German Startup Isar Aerospace Attempts Second Spectrum Launch From Norway for European Orbital Sovereignty

key_facts.fact: Isar Aerospace is attempting a second orbital launch of its Spectrum rocket from Andøya Spaceport in northern Norway on March 25, after its first attempt in 2025 ended in failure.
key_facts.excerpt: Private German rocket will try to make history on March 25... Isar Aerospace, a German startup, is attempting a second orbital launch of its Spectrum rocket from Andøya Spaceport in northern Norway.

key_facts.fact: If successful, Spectrum would mark the first time a European private company reaches orbit from continental European soil, a milestone for European space sovereignty.
key_facts.excerpt: If Spectrum reaches orbit, Europe will have demonstrated the ability to launch from continental soil, reducing the historical dependency on foreign launch sites.

key_facts.fact: The mission is ESA's qualifying second launch under its Boost! commercial space transport program, carrying five cubesats and a science experiment.
key_facts.excerpt: Spectrum's qualifying second launch... five cubesats and a science experiment.

sources.title: Private German rocket will try to make history on March 25: Watch it live
